page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the printed page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes. Signature mark at the bottom right.

main_text.p: arcus in ea effigurandi, cum vifu noftro intermedio, ac centro corporis lunaris, fit in una linea recta.

Quapropter arcus Iridis femicirculum magnitudine nunquam excedit: fed vel exacte aequat, quando videlicet tempore iridis luminare eft in Ortu five Occafu; vel minor eft femicirculo, cum luminare fupra ortum aut occafum aliquantum exftat.
Meridiano autem tempore nulla cerni poteft Iris.
Iris folaris eft arcus, tribus coloribus maxime, purpureo,viridi ac ceruleo, confpicuus, a Solis radiis effiguratus.

Quando autem Iris refplendefcit, ita ut duae irides confpiciantur: tum pofterior obscurior imago eft prioris: habebitq; colores illius ordine inverso refpondentes, fufcum, feu ceruleum primum, viridem fecundum, purpureu tertium.
Iris lunaris eft arcus, colore pallidiore & albicante, a radiis Lunae factus.
Fitq; hęc Iris tantum Luna plena aut gibbos ã[?] exfiftente: nam reliquo tempore radii ejus nimis imbecilles funt.
unde rarius apparent Irides lunares, quam folares.
Quae etiam caufa eft, cur nullæ ab aliis ftellis fiant irides.

page.notes: Word "Iris" alone at the end of the paragraph before the small heading is set off on its own line in the print; kept in the paragraph. Doubtful: "ã[?]" (the word after "gibbos", perhaps à or a). Signature "H4" at lower right is uncertain. Printing peculiarities left as printed: "purpureu", "habebitq;", "fufcum, feu", "exacte". No catchword visible.
